Services Teaching staff mobility: international agreements Home International Going abroad Teaching Staff Mobility Ascolta Contenuto Mobility under institutional agreements MoU and PE Based on the University Guidelines, applications for funding for research and/or teaching missions abroad are open for the year 2026 within the framework of the agreements Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) and abroad Safety Abroad Ascolta Contenuto The University of Trieste is committed to protecting the health of students, researchers and all technical and administrative staff. This is all the more true when it comes to safety abroad. Our University was the coordinator of the MAECI-CRUI panel for drafting the guidelines approved by the Conference of Italian University Rectors (CRUI) on security abroad, and since 2023 it has had an agreement in place with the Crisis Unit of the Italian Ministry for Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI) to guarantee constant direct communication with Italian diplomatic offices around the world. Are you about to leave? Safety still comes first! (video in Italian) Before leaving Find out about your destination (social, political and security context, local customs, habits and religion) Download the MAECI Crisis Unit app where you will find useful information on your destination country Check which vaccinations are compulsory and find out about any necessary health precautions Check the validity of your documents (passport, identity card) and take a photocopy with you when you with you when you travel (which you should store separately from the original) In particular, check whether your passport is valid for the duration of your trip and has at least one blank page for stamps Do not forget your European Health Insurance Card (EHIC - back of health insurance card) if you are going to an EU country For non-EU travel: check if you need health insurance and if so, what constitutes adequate cover. Your insurance should be able to cover not only the costs of medical treatment, but also possible repatriation by emergency air ambulance or transfer to another country If you take regular medication , make sure you bring an adequate supply Sign up for dovesiamonelmondo.it website (also through the Crisis Unit app) Upon arrival If you buy a local phone card, remember to enter the new number on dovesiamonelmondo.it Save any telephone numbers for local contacts (tutor, reference secretary of the host institution, etc.) and the country's emergency numbers on your phone If destination country is considered to be at risk: inform the Italian diplomatic representation (Embassy, Consulate) of all the details of your trip. In the event of an emergency, attack or other serious event Avoid or move away from the affected area as soon as possible Stay in your home/hotel Stay informed through the media and follow the instructions of the local authorities Communicate your location to the diplomatic representation on site Tell your family you are safe (via text message, social media, telephone) who must then notify the MAECI Crisis Unit (Unità di Crisi) General advice If you choose to stay abroad for several months makes sure you do any medical examinations you may need before leaving (ophthalmologist, dentist, etc.) Avoid crowds and/or protests Observe appropriate health and hygiene precautions (e.g. drink only from sealed bottles, do not add ice to drinks, eat only well-cooked meat, etc.). Wear appropriate clothing (especially in places of worship) Do not photograph or film military bases Use general common sense at all times Ultimo aggiornamento Last update: 27 February 2025 Going abroad Double and Joint Degrees Safety Abroad Useful links Titolo interno Viaggiare Sicuri -MAECI Crisis Unit App Call to action Download the App Titolo interno Website Dove siamo nel Mondo Call to action Go to the website Piazzale Europa, 1 - 34127 - Trieste, Italia - Tel. +39 040 558 7111 - P.IVA 00211830328 C.F. 80013890324 - P.E.C. ateneo@pec.units.it Piazzale Europa, 1 - 34127 - Trieste, Italia - Tel. +39 040 558 7111 - P.IVA 00211830328 C.F. 80013890324 - P.E.C. ateneo@pec.units.it ANVUR Class A Locations Contacts Public Relations Office (URP) Official Register Transparent Administration Work with us Calls for tender, real estate auctions and suppliers E-envoicing Payment methods Accessibility Privacy Social Media policy Cookie settings University Directory University Corporate Identity Online services Support UniTS Store UniTS Instagram Facebook LinkedIn YouTube X Threads Rss data > extlink > mailtoclass: 0 data > extlink > mailtolabel: (link sends email) data > extlink > extfamailtoclasses: fa fa-envelope-o config > cookie > name: cookiesjsr config > library > libbasepath: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/jfeltkamp/cookiesjsr@1/dist config > library > libpath: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/jfeltkamp/cookiesjsr@1/dist/cookiesjsr.min.js default > services > name: Necessary cookies tracking > services > name: Matomo Analytics video > services > name: Video forniti da YouTube translation > default > title: What are Cookies? Wear appropriate clothing (especially in places of worship) Do not photograph or film military bases Use general common sense at all times Ultimo aggiornamento Last update: 27 February 2025 Going abroad Double and Joint Degrees Safety Abroad Useful links Titolo interno Viaggiare Sicuri -MAECI Crisis Unit App Call to action Download the App Titolo interno Website Dove siamo nel Mondo Call to action Go to the website Piazzale Europa, 1 - 34127 - Trieste, Italia - Tel. +39 040 558 7111 - P.IVA 00211830328 C.F. 80013890324 - P.E.C. ateneo@pec.units.it Piazzale Europa, 1 - 34127 - Trieste, Italia - Tel. +39 040 558 7111 - P.IVA 00211830328 C.F. 80013890324 - P.E.C. ateneo@pec.units.it ANVUR Class A Locations Contacts Public Relations Office (URP) Official Register Transparent Administration Work with us Calls for tender, real estate auctions and suppliers E-envoicing Payment methods Accessibility Privacy Social Media policy Cookie settings University Directory University Corporate Identity Online services Support UniTS Store UniTS Instagram Facebook LinkedIn YouTube X Threads Rss data > extlink > mailtoclass: 0 data > extlink > mailtolabel: (link sends email) data > extlink > extfamailtoclasses: fa fa-envelope-o config > cookie > name: cookiesjsr config > library > libbasepath: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/jfeltkamp/cookiesjsr@1/dist config > library > libpath: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/jfeltkamp/cookiesjsr@1/dist/cookiesjsr.min.js default > services > name: Necessary cookies tracking > services > name: Matomo Analytics video > services > name: Video forniti da YouTube translation > default > title: What are Cookies? Home International International Cooperation Ascolta Contenuto The University of Trieste firmly believes that internationalization must adopt a global outlook, embracing an interdisciplinary approach to address global imbalances and propose sustainable solutions, in order to promote education, knowledge, development, and the protection of international human rights. With these aims in mind, the Research Center on Migration and Development Cooperation (CRMCS) was also established. Find out more about UniTS International Cooperation Science Diplomacy Science Diplomacy has become progressively important over the last two decades. It describes the intersection between foreign policy of the countries, science policies and the missions of the universities and concerns both international cooperation in research and training and the international projection of the third mission of universities. The University of Trieste has numerous experiences and plays an active role in science diplomacy international scenario. Internazionale Cooperazione internazionale Ascolta Contenuto L’Università di Trieste crede fermamente che l'internazionalizzazione debba avere uno sguardo globale adottando un approccio interdisciplinare per affrontare squilibri globali e proporre soluzioni sostenibili, per favorire istruzione, conoscenza, sviluppo e tutela dei diritti umani internazionali. Con questi fini è stato creato anche il Centro di Ricerca sulle Migrazioni e la Cooperazione allo Sviluppo - CRMCS. Scopri di più sulla cooperazione internazionale di UniTS La Diplomazia Scientifica La diplomazia scientifica è diventata progressivamente importante negli ultimi due decenni. Descrive l'intersezione tra la politica estera dei Paesi, le politiche della scienza e le missioni delle università e riguarda sia la cooperazione internazionale nella ricerca e nella formazione sia la proiezione internazionale della terza missione delle università. L’Università degli Studi di Trieste vanta numerose esperienze e svolge un ruolo attivo nello scenario internazionale della diplomazia della scienza. L’Università degli Studi di Trieste vanta numerose esperienze e svolge un ruolo attivo nello scenario internazionale della diplomazia della scienza. International Going abroad Double and Joint Degrees Ascolta Contenuto The University of Trieste offers international study programmes in collaboration with one or more partner universities, with part of the study pathway undertaken abroad. Upon completion, selected students are awarded a Double Degree , receiving a diploma from UniTS and a diploma from the partner university. The activities involve attending courses and taking the relevant exams at the partner universities, as stipulated in the individual agreements. Call for Applications – Double Degrees and Outgoing Students The university-wide call for applications for participation in Double Degree (DJD) programmes is published annually on the International Mobility page ( only italian version ). For most programmes, departures refer to the academic year following the publication of the call. For information about the call, please contact the International Mobility Office ( outgoing.students@amm.units.it ). International Going abroad Double and Joint Degrees Ascolta Contenuto The University of Trieste offers international study programmes in collaboration with one or more partner universities, with part of the study pathway undertaken abroad. Upon completion, selected students are awarded a Double Degree , receiving a diploma from UniTS and a diploma from the partner university. The activities involve attending courses and taking the relevant exams at the partner universities, as stipulated in the individual agreements. Call for Applications – Double Degrees and Outgoing Students The university-wide call for applications for participation in Double Degree (DJD) programmes is published annually on the International Mobility page ( only italian version ).
